guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：張量運算加速器
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Tensor-compute accelerators
guides.concept: 以脈動陣列、混合精度與編譯映射連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect systolic arrays, mixed precision and compiler mapping through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「張量維度」的資料、控制與時間關係。矩陣相乘的內維度必須相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對 M×K 與 K×N 形狀。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「資料平鋪」的資料、控制與時間關係。維度不整除會產生邊緣空槽。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較整齊與零補齊矩陣。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「雙緩衝」的資料、控制與時間關係。載入與運算重疊需要足夠緩衝。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較串列與重疊時程。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「累加精度」的資料、控制與時間關係。低精度輸入可配較高精度累加。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤長點積的捨入誤差。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「編譯映射」的資料、控制與時間關係。融合可減少交通但增加局部資源。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較融合前後暫存量。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「精度驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。速度提升需同時核對任務品質。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較基準誤差與吞吐變化。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for tensor dimensions. Matrix inner dimensions must agree. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check M×K and K×N shapes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for data tiling. Nondivisible dimensions create edge waste. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare aligned and padded matrices. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for double buffering. Load/compute overlap needs sufficient buffering. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare serial and overlapping schedules. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for accumulation precision. Low-precision inputs may use wider accumulation. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace rounding in a long dot product. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for compiler mapping. Fusion saves traffic but consumes local resources. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare temporary storage before and after fusion. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for accuracy acceptance. Speedups require task-quality checks. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare reference error and throughput changes. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「輸入管線」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分離讀取、轉換與運算耗時。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「精度驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「速度提升需同時核對任務品質。」。
提交「精度驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較基準誤差與吞吐變化。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit input pipeline input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit accuracy acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit accuracy acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：峰值 FLOP/s 可直接當作端到端訓練吞吐。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Peak FLOP/s equals end-to-end training throughput. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

practice: 由「張量維度」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。

將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From tensor dimensions, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "GPUs expose general threads; systolic arrays specialize matrix flows", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
